proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: The class follows the printed legend of the code, not the letter: where the legend reads 'Not Approved' or 'Rejected' (LACASA stamp 'CODE D - NOT APPROVED', Modular form 'D. Rejected', SAIFCO form '(D) Rejected Material') the class is 'rejected'; only where a template's own legend for D reads revise/resubmit is it 'revise and resubmit'. A bare letter D with no legend visible on the page defaults to 'rejected' (conventions section 5). A layout helper must not map D to 'revise and resubmit' unless the page's legend says so.
